items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I read it with him and all the people in Chicago when he first went up there. It was baffling the way he and King Oliver did that together so great...

ctx.x: Is the second a little more difficult to play, second trumpet?

Well, I mean, especially when you're not reading the music, you understand? It's an off harmony, see? And quite naturally, if you don't have the year, it's just like if you try to sing a song and I'm trying to do the alto part behind you or the tenor part, I don't have the music in front of me. Well, he's got that from memory and feeling on his fingers. And he was perfect at it. He did, you know. Matter of fact, that's what Lewis stated in that last book.
